exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. The Run 53–57 RA, Seismic, Soma, Sublunar, 30D, No.Identity, Aedi, Evod, Echoveil and Molecular lanes were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

Terrain — Barossa Dub and Hive were not retained: they already appear in GROOVE OVER NOISE history, which was read only for duplicate control and was not mutated. Terrain — Scatter is a different exact track.

No lead was promoted for recency, label reputation, genre, title, novelty, structural cleverness or BPM. Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
